properties.name: show_today
properties.comment: Whether the "Today:" line is shown below the months.

properties.name: show_today_circle
properties.comment: Whether today's day publishes the current state and its marker part.

properties.name: show_week_numbers
properties.comment: Week numbers beside each row: week 1 is the week that holds 1 January (Windows Forms' FirstDay rule), weeks starting on first_day_of_week.

properties.name: first_day_of_week
properties.comment: The weekday each week row starts on.
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("MonthCalendar first day of week is invalid");

properties.name: calendar_dimensions
properties.comment: The months shown, as columns by rows; one to twelve months in all.
hand: written keeps the first month in range and the focus date visible

properties.name: max_selection_count
properties.comment: The most days a selection may hold; zero throws std::out_of_range.
hand: written trims the selection to the new count

properties.name: scroll_change
properties.comment: Months an arrow scrolls; zero (the default) scrolls by the number of months shown.
prepare: if (incoming > 20000U) throw std::out_of_range("MonthCalendar scroll change is at most 20000 months");

properties.name: format_provider
properties.comment: Month and day names and the "Today:" date pattern.

properties.name: font
properties.comment: The font of the title, the days and the "Today:" line.
prepare: if (!valid_font_spec(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("MonthCalendar font specification is invalid");
